_comment: Few-shot examples for prompt variant C (vlm/run_predictions.py crops --variant C --fewshot-examples). Chosen from eval/gold_real/gold_people_saniya.csv: video1 (2018-03-15...), box_h > 150, visible=да, kept=true, three different colors, none black, and no near-copy of the same person (IoU > 0.3, same gold color) on other snapshots of video1. color/type = Saniya's labels; description is a template made from them (the gold has no description). crop_path is relative to the repo root; on the server the crop is found through --crops-index by (video_id, snapshot_id, person_idx). Score with: python3 -m eval.score_methods people ... --exclude-file eval/gold_real/fewshot_examples.json
